vm.firmware: OVMF UEFI: /usr/share/OVMF/OVMF_CODE_4M.fd (readonly pflash) + a copy of OVMF_VARS_4M.fd
vm.command_line: nice -n 19 ionice -c3 timeout 14400 qemu-system-x86_64 -name truenas-console-capture -machine q35 -accel tcg,thread=multi -cpu max -smp 2 -m 3072 -drive if=pflash,format=raw,readonly=on,file=/usr/share/OVMF/OVMF_CODE_4M.fd -drive if=pflash,format=raw,file=$W/OVMF_VARS.fd -drive file=$W/disk.qcow2,format=qcow2,if=none,id=hd0,cache=writeback -device virtio-blk-pci,drive=hd0,bootindex=2 -drive file=$ISO,format=raw,media=cdrom,readonly=on,if=none,id=cd0 -device ide-cd,drive=cd0,bootindex=1 -nic user,model=virtio-net-pci -device virtio-vga -display none -monitor none -qmp unix:$W/qmp.sock,server=on,wait=off -pidfile $W/qemu.pid -serial file:$W/serial.log
vm.note_display_adapter: The first attempt used '-device VGA' (std VGA): QMP screendump of the installed-kernel framebuffer returned a static garbage image (11 frames kept, stored outside git in /home/vscode/console-corpus/frames-attempt1-stdvga) and the guest sat idle. virtio-vga gives a correct 1280x800 screendump. Not root-caused; do not assume it is a TrueNAS fault.

frames.resolution: 1280x800 RGB PNG (QMP screendump format=png); text is rendered by the guest as 8x16 pixel cells (160 columns x 50 rows) in the Linux console and newt dialogs
frames.series_location: /home/vscode/console-corpus/frames/frames (not in git; 5.4 MB); per-frame records in series-manifest.jsonl here
frames.note_naming: curated names are NN-<what>.png; their origin in the full series is in the README table

capture.keep_rule: fraction of pixels whose luma differs by more than 48 from the last kept frame >= threshold; a change confined to a 24x40 px box is held one poll and dropped if the next poll is back to the base frame (cursor blink)
capture.threshold_lesson: 0.0002 (=205 px at 1280x800) is too high: the '[*]' checkbox change in the disk picker (about 40 px) was not kept until the threshold was lowered; use ~0.00002 (20 px) at this resolution

key_sequence: GRUB: default entry auto-selected after timeout (no key)
Choose Destination Media: Space (select vda), Enter
Web UI Authentication Method: Enter (1 Administrative user truenas_admin)
Password: type 'truenas-test', Down, type 'truenas-test', Enter (throwaway test value)
Installation Succeeded: Enter (returns to the installer's own Console Setup menu)
Console Setup: Down, Down, Enter (3 Reboot System)
ISO was still attached and booted first: GRUB(ISO) started again; detached the medium via QMP blockdev-open-tray + blockdev-remove-medium (qdev path), then system_reset
Installed GRUB: default entry auto-selected; installed system booted to the Console setup menu
keys_file: keys.jsonl (every send with timestamp, seconds since capture start)
host_safety: load peak 5.64, MemAvailable minimum 4.74 GiB during the run (guard.log); no abort
